start.text: The new defenses are in place. The insider does not need to break in. He already has the keys.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! It does not shoot from outside this time. It appears inside, it copies a little at a time, and it walks files out.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A badge inside the room, a slow copy and a walk-out. That is three tricks.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: That is what makes it hard. The access is real.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: [b][color=red]Trusted access[/color][/b]: a badge appears inside and bursts. [b][color=red]Slow copy[/color][/b]: a trickle that grows. [b][color=red]Walk-out[/color][/b]: carriers take files out unless you guard them.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without that defense, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to [b][color=green]Expose[/color][/b] the threat and hit it. When it attacks, you dodge, and you stay near a file to guard it. Keep going until it is [b][color=green]contained[/color][/b].
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. Let's stop it before anything else leaves.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
